title: Multi-Stage Phase-Aware Self-Supervised Reconstruction for Multi-Echo Gradient-Echo MRI
abstract: arXiv:2611.13352v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Purpose: To develop a phase-aware self-supervised framework for accelerated high-resolution multi-echo gradient-echo (mGRE) MRI that preserves anatomical detail and complex echo information for quantitative mapping. Methods: We developed multi-stage phase-aware self-supervised reconstruction (MSPR-GRE), integrating progressive k-space expansion with phase estimation and refinement. Sequential unrolled networks reconstruct complex multi-echo images and update echo-dependent phase priors. A relaxation-informed temporal subspace is used for acquisitions with at least four echoes, while shorter echo trains are reconstructed in the image domain. Training uses held-out acquired k-space samples without fully sampled targets. Evaluation included 9.4 T ex vivo mouse-brain data 30um eight-echo and 18um dual-echo) and retrospectively undersampled 7 T AHEAD human-brain data, with supervised ablations. translated_title: 多级相位感知自监督重建用于多回波梯度回波MRI
translated_abstract: 目的：开发一种相位感知的自监督框架，用于加速高分辨率多回波梯度回波（mGRE）MRI成像，在定量图谱中保留解剖细节和复数回波信息。方法：我们开发了多级相位感知自监督重建（MSPR-GRE），将渐进式k空间扩展与相位估计和精细化相结合。顺序展开网络重建复数多回波图像并更新依赖回波的相位先验。对于至少包含四个回波的采集，使用基于弛豫信息的时间子空间，而较短的回波序列则在图像域中重建。训练使用留出的实际采集k空间样本，无需全采样目标数据。评估包括9.4 T离体小鼠脑数据（30微米八回波和18微米双回波）以及回顾性欠采样的7 T AHEAD人脑数据，并进行了监督消融实验。结果：MSPR-GRE减少了...区域的伪影（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种多级相位感知自监督重建框架MSPR-GRE，通过渐进式k空间扩展与相位估计精化相结合，在无需全采样训练数据的条件下实现加速高分辨率多回波梯度回波MRI重建，同时保留解剖细节与复数回波信息。
en_tdlr: Proposes MSPR-GRE, a multi-stage phase-aware self-supervised reconstruction framework that integrates progressive k-space expansion with phase estimation and refinement, enabling accelerated high-resolution multi-echo gradient-echo MRI reconstruction without fully sampled training targets while preserving anatomical detail and complex echo information.
